name: Kazami Jun'ya
source:
The protagonist of the Hayarigami series. 

He was once a promising detective in the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's Criminal Investigation Bureau's Section 1. At the start of the game, he was ordered to be transferred to the MPD's Historical Archives Section instead, located on the 5th basement floor, due to a troubling incident that involved him.
His rank is lieutenant. He has good running skills, and he rarely misses the criminal in the chase.
